set1.q: Which structure gives the extra one to two millimetres of lid elevation when a patient is startled?
opts: Correct, and it is sympathetically innervated, which is why Horner syndrome causes mild ptosis.

Correct, so inequality means an efferent pathway has failed.

They should be equal unless a pathway fails.

First-order neurons run from hypothalamus to cord.

Correct, with possible lung injury proposed.

Correct, which is why onset age matters.
It is always symptomatic regardless of onset
Early onset is the stated exception.
